pages.title: The Crown Is Still Hot
pages.text: Deliberately use an earned crown’s conditional fire bonus.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The crown increases offense while burning, with a further lava bonus. Do not enter lava without reliable protection; the goal never requires death or overriding server rules.
